name: Beneath The Willows
source:
Sekibanki has a date coming up, and her friends insist on getting involved. Can she win an umbrella youkai's heart in spite of their meddling? And will she be able to say what needs to be said before the world forces her hand?

[From [url=https://fionakaenbyou.itch.io/beneath-the-willows]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Sekibanki即将有个约会，她的朋友们坚持要参加。尽管有伞妖怪的干涉，她能否赢得伞妖怪的芳心呢？在世界迫使她采取行动之前，她能说出需要说的话吗？

[来自[url=https://fionakaenbyou.itch.io/beneath-the-willows]itch.io[/url]]
